subject: Sync note: Implementation plan for quality-monitoring, eval integration & canary policy
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@lumenhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Engineering <sarah.eng@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps for Lumen QMon setup

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — team loved the low-latency routing options. We're ready to move forward with the quality-monitoring setup but want to be concrete about what success looks like and how we'll handle regressions during rollout. Specific asks from eng/ops:

- We'll hand over an initial prompt set (clinical triage and insurance verification flows). We need guidance on how to version and wire these into your eval harness.
- We need an integration plan for the eval harness to run nightly regressions and alert on quality drops.
- We want a canary policy for model/quantization rollouts (how to compare canary vs baseline, failure thresholds, and automated rollback).

I've attached the prompt CSV export from our test workspace. Can your team propose a practical implementation plan with milestones?

Best,
Elena
Elena Park
Head of Product, Conversational AI
Lumen Health

Attachments: lumen_promptset_v1.csv (CSV)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps for Lumen QMon setup

Elena — great to see the prompt set, thanks. Looping in Marissa (CS lead for onboarding) and Priyom (implementation engineer) who will run the integration.

High level proposal (we'll turn this into a one-pager + timeline):

1) Triage & mapping (3 business days)
   - Priyom will review the CSV and map prompts to measurement metrics (accuracy/safety/slot-fill).
   - We'll recommend an initial eval metric set and baseline thresholds.

2) Eval harness integration (5 business days)
   - Ship a small adapter that runs your prompt set nightly against a pinned baseline model and candidate model(s).
   - Output: daily regression report + delta metrics; failing tests will create alerts in Slack and a Jira ticket if above threshold.

3) Canary rollout policy (2 business days to configure; then ongoing)
   - Canary traffic: start with 5% traffic to candidate; monitor perimeter metrics + prompt-set regressions.
   - Failure conditions: if aggregated metric drop > X% (we propose 4%), or any safety test fails, rollback automatically to baseline.

4) Handoff & runbook (2 business days)
   - We'll deliver the runbook, automation hooks (API endpoints to promote/rollback), and a short training session for your ops team.

Action items for you: confirm which metrics you care about first (accuracy on triage, critical safety checks, average response time). Also confirm DoS windows for nightly runs.

Marissa/Priyom — can you pick up the CSV review and produce the adapter spec by EOD Thu?

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Park <elena.park@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 08:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps for Lumen QMon setup

Taking the CSV now. Quick technical notes from initial pass:

- Prompt-set shape: ~420 prompts across 3 intent groups (triage, benefits-check, coverage-verification). Good separation for focused metrics.
- Suggest canonical IDs for prompts (prompt_id) and a short gold_response field for deterministic evals. I added comments in the attached integration notes.
- For the eval harness: we'll provide a Dockerized runner that accepts a prompt CSV + model spec and emits an HTML + JSON artifact. The JSON will be pushed nightly to your S3.

Open questions for Lumen:
- Do you have established gold responses for the triage prompts, or do you want Redwood to generate initial gold answers for review?
- Slack channel for nightly regressions (we can post to a dedicated #lumen-qmon).

I'll attach the integration checklist and a first-draft mapping in the next message.

Cheers,
Priyom
Senior Implementation Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: eval-harness-integration-notes.md (markdown)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@lumenhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 11:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps for Lumen QMon setup

Elena — great to align. Couple of operational details from CS perspective:

- Rollout cadence: recommend 2-week canaries for major model/quantization changes, with daily regression checks during the first week and every-other-day checks in week two.
- Alerting thresholds (proposal):
   * Accuracy drop (triage intents): 3% relative drop triggers engineering review, 6% triggers rollback.
   * Safety test failure (any): immediate rollback.
   * Latency regression (p95): +35% sustained over 30m triggers circuit-breaker.

- We will provide a canary dashboard with side-by-side metrics, and a one-click promote/rollback button (requires ops approval).

Next steps (concrete):
1) Priyom to deliver adapter + integration notes (ETA: EOD Thu).
2) Lumen to flag which prompts have gold answers vs. need review.
3) Redwood will send the canary policy draft (PDF) for legal/ops review by Friday.

I'll schedule a 30-min handoff session Friday 10/2 at 2pm PT to walk through the runbook and who does what during a regression. If that works for you, I'll send an invite.

- Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Elena Park <elena.park@lumenhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps for Lumen QMon setup

Thanks team — that timeline looks good and Friday 2pm PT works. A couple clarifications before the call:

- We'll provide gold responses for the top 120 triage prompts by Thursday EOD; for the rest, we'll ask Redwood to generate initial golds for review.
- For the automated rollback: will the rollback be triggered automatically by the harness, or do you gate with manual approval? We prefer automated rollback for safety failures but manual for small accuracy deltas.

Agreed on channel — create #lumen-qmon in Slack and add the engineering rotation. Also please share the canary-rollback-policy-draft.pdf ahead of the meeting so our compliance team can peek.

See you Fri.

Elena

Attachments referenced: canary-rollback-policy-draft.pdf (PDF)
